description: This file defines policies and utility functions for managing tools and permissions for sub-agents within a larger agent system, including deny lists, session-based policies, and group policies.

methods.name: resolveSubagentDenyList
methods.description: Determines the deny list of tools for a sub-agent based on its depth and maximum spawn depth.

methods.name: resolveSubagentDenyListForRole
methods.description: Returns the deny list of tools for a sub-agent based on its role ('leaf' or other).

methods.name: resolveSubagentToolPolicy
methods.description: Builds the tool policy (allow/deny) for a sub-agent based on configuration and depth.

methods.name: resolveSubagentToolPolicyForSession
methods.description: Builds the tool policy for a sub-agent based on session capabilities and configuration.

methods.name: filterToolsByPolicy
methods.description: Filters a list of tools based on a given sandbox policy.

methods.name: resolveGroupToolPolicy
methods.description: Determines the group-level tool policy based on session and group context.
